notes.title: Next Fest demo just dropped!
notes.content:
Welcome to Next Fest! Ready to play a rotating tower defense where you can adjust turret defenses in real-time?

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h3]Starship[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now pick any starship you’ve unlocked to start a new journey in "Ranger" mode.
[*] Starships have upgradeable items.
[*] Each starship has its own recycle efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/99c454a921b1aa4b3383f2774e1be144bc972b9b.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added variety to enemy spawning patterns.
[*][spoiler]And new enemy, of course. [/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain enemy body parts shouldn’t collide with starships.
[*] [Nerf] Missile: reduced AOE range.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked difficulty mode selections.
[*] Replaced the recycle button icon for better clarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/662dd6ffd168e444358e3379bff8de35cd213595.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now opt in or out of tutorials.
[*] Reduced starship rotation inertia.
[*] You can now dismiss upgrade/transform guidance by clicking, instead of waiting.
[*] Made in-game sound effect clearer (louder).
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
Improved resource usage for animations.

[h2]Look Back[/h2]
Stellar Watch has been playable in its alpha/demo state for a year now. We’ve met incredible players and developers, both online and offline, from around the world. This helped us turn our design philosophy into practice, and we learned how to:
[list]
[*] Strip away as much grinding as possible and get straight to the fun parts. (Yay!)
[*] Maintain a minimalist style by minimizing information on screen while still providing just enough for players to make strategic decisions. (The most challenging one!)
[*] Introduce mechanics gradually at the right pace, avoiding overwhelming players at the start.
[*] Make a tower defense game playable by gamepad.
[/list]
We've learned a lot, and this game is far from perfect. If you’ve ever played the demo, please share your feedback with us. We look forward to making Stellar Watch an even more exciting game for its upcoming full release.

[list]
[*] Explorer: for casual players who want to have a relaxed tower defense experience. With additional resources, explore the universe at your own pace.
[*] Defender: standard Stellar Watch gameplay.
[*] Ranger: for players seeking more challenges, [spoiler]starship(s) receive permanent damages[/spoiler]. Plan your every move carefully!

notes.title: Demo 2.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h3]Enemy Variants[/h3]
We've introduced new enemy variants to enrich your gameplay experience.
[h3]Limiting RNG[/h3]
While randomness still plays a crucial role in gameplay, we've now constrained the level difficulty variance. Although levels can range from easy to quite challenging across different playthroughs, the difficulty will no longer swing from trivial to nearly impossible. This change ensures a fairer and more consistent challenge within a predefined difficulty range.


[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Drones: Introduced a brief invincibility period after taking damage, giving players a short respite to recover or reposition.
[*] [Nerf] Missile: We've reduced the damage caused by direct missile hits, balancing its impact in gameplay.
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] New players will now see highlighted information on transformable and upgradable drones, making it easier to understand these key game features from the start.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Graphics Controls: Added options for windowed/fullscreen modes and screen resolution settings, allowing for a more customized visual experience.
[*] Gamepad Clarity: For those using gamepads, it's now clearer which drone you're selecting, improving the interface's intuitiveness.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/26f371e7acd0d231ebd3a3f69868fd75ea4dec61.png[/img]

[b]Aiming for a More Refined Experience[/b] With these updates, our goal is to enhance your journey through the game, making each session more enjoyable and less frustrating. We're excited for you to dive into the updated game, and as always, your feedback is invaluable to us for future improvements. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Taipei Game Show 2024 & Demo 2.8
notes.content:
We're thrilled to return to the Taipei Game Show! With valuable feedback from our community and to welcome new players, we've implemented several key updates to enhance your gaming experience.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h3]Stasis Vision Mode[/h3]
Recognizing the need for strategic pauses in the heat of battle, we're introducing the Stasis Vision mode. Now, you can temporarily halt the game to view all drone attack ranges and enemy positions. This feature is designed to help you recalibrate and devise the best possible strategy on the fly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/03fbc8b4bb4afcb707faea37c0ee752ce49d0e93.gif[/img]


[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Buff] Prism: Price reduction to make it a more accessible option in your arsenal.
[*] [Nerf] Carrier: Increased replenish time to balance its powerful impact on gameplay.
[*] [Nerf] Missile: Slightly reduced attack range to maintain fair play and challenge.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The drone deployment info panel now displays unlocked transformable and/or upgradable drones, allowing quicker and more informed decisions about drone deployment.
[*] Enhanced clarity of pause menu buttons for better navigation.
[*] Added a "Resume" button in the pause menu to prevent accidental game restarts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/e224b989efce3544ec69e9637feefd1674c40f6b.png[/img]

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized main menu and pause menu button animations for a smoother interface experience.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects (SFX) hints for speed up mode, enhancing the overall game feel.
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial Revamp[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked tutorial sections related to drone transformation and upgrades for a more intuitive and seamless introduction to these game mechanics.
[/list]

We hope these updates make your experience with Stellar Watch more enjoyable and engaging. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we're committed to continuously improving the game. See you at the Taipei Game Show!

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2023 & Demo 2.6 with Steam Deck Support
notes.content:
Hey fellow Watch!
[h2]We are live at Tokyo Game Show! [/h2]
Big news! Today marks the start of the Tokyo Game Show, and we're honored to showcase Stellar Watch as part of the exclusive "Selected Indie 80" lineup. It's a dream come true!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/f8f5a9c0b8bd04651eeeac1a022ee21c9e6b4c8d.jpg[/img]


[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h3]Game on with your controller & Steam Deck![/h3]
You asked, we delivered! Dive into the Stellar Watch universe with our newly integrated controller support. And yes, you can now strategize and conquer from your couch or while on the move with your Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/73c2a098b6404fd36e8e4b0755a90b60cbeae24f.gif[/img]


[h2]What's Changed?[/h2]

[h3]Meet your new shielded adversary[/h3]
We listened to the brave souls who battled our new shielded adversary and have fine-tuned the balance to better accommodate various tactical approaches.

[h3]Tech Tree Gets a Facelift[/h3]
We've revamped the tech tree to facilitate a more intuitive planning process for your drone transformations and unlocks. Now, you can quickly pinpoint which drone evolves into which, streamlining your pathway to victory.


Thank you for being on this journey with us. Let's keep making Stellar Watch stellar!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1 Notes
notes.content:
Hello fellow Watch,

We're back with another update, fine-tuning your experience and addressing some balance issues along with quality of life improvements. We've carefully studied your feedback and made changes accordingly. Here's what's new and changed:

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Nerf] Spinner: Attack range decreased.
[*] [Nerf] Laser: Attack range decreased.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tech Description: To assist with strategic decisions, we've added tech descriptions for each attainable star. This makes the information more accessible for players when deciding which path to choose.
[*] Spaceship Thrust: We've made the spaceship thrust more visible, helping you identify your rotation direction more easily.
[*] Ship Yard: To reduce confusion, the Ship Yard is now enabled only when you own more than one ship.
[/list]
We'd like to take a moment to express our gratitude for your invaluable feedback received at MomoCon, on YouTube, and on the forums. Your input is vital to us and directly contributes to the ongoing refinement of Stellar Watch. For more discussions, join us on our Discord server. Or feel free to email us at: contact (at) stellarwatch (dot) gg

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo 2.0 is Out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Our updated demo is now live on Steam and it's packed with new features and enhancements. Our primary goal was to provide players with more crucial information, thus facilitating better decision-making, all while maintaining a consistent aesthetic.


[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[h3]Ship Yard[/h3]
New ships are now unlockable! Each one with its unique HP, dark matter, turn speed, and formation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/08ac837cbc7219919359c6df75ffb4974dfa07e8.gif[/img]

[h3]Tech Tree[/h3]
Now, you can track the techs you've unlocked during your journey. This feature will aid in making strategic decisions when choosing routes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/c2a4aa6fd18af7962a6ebba196d2469634569f77.gif[/img]

[h3]Drone Information Panel[/h3]
Quickly determine which drone to deploy next. For the tactics enthusiasts, we've included detailed stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42539338/9ccefcb1201bb06e484ded6cd5b575e7027acd95.gif[/img]


[h2]What's changed?[/h2]

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
We've reworked the tutorial to keep it concise yet more informative for new players entering the Stellar Watch universe.

[h3]Mods Animation[/h3]
Updated animations enable players to understand the current status of drones with certain mods equipped.
 
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Buff] Missile: AOE range increased.
[*] [Buff] Pulse - Ricochet Mod: Increased probability of jumping to nearby enemies.
[*] [Nerf] All Level 2 Drones: Increased cost.
[*] [Nerf] Missile - Cluster Mod: Decreased attack range of hot-launched missiles.
[*] [Buff] Spinner: Increased rotation speed.

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brightness: We've introduced adjustable brightness settings to enhance your gaming comfort
[*] Combat Slow Motion: While choosing drones to deploy, upgrade, or sell, we've slightly reduced the game speed to prevent unexpected enemy hits when resuming normal speed.
